scope: One bounded read-only process/input-inventory/log review. No E: source rehash, source/model download, source-code edit, process intervention or production-gold read.

inventory.limitation: Inventory bytes were taken from the existing frozen-input inventory, not independently rehashed or restatted.

active_run_observation.limitation: Partial live outputs/journal metadata were read for resource context only; no terminal-seal verification or evaluator join was performed.

memory_units.working_set: Resident host memory at sample time; shared/mapped pages may be included.
memory_units.peak_working_set: OS per-process lifetime peak resident host memory, not a sum of simultaneous system peaks. CIM PeakWorkingSetSize is KiB and was converted to bytes.
memory_units.private_committed: Windows private committed pages, not resident memory and not GPU VRAM.
memory_units.gpu: nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory --format=csv,noheader,nounits returned 6316, [N/A]. Per-process GPU usage is unavailable, not zero.

runtime_facts.interpretation: The start-time gap includes launcher pre-server work. Arm elapsed_seconds excludes source-inclusive _load_case, external verify_case and native startup; it is not pure token-generation time.

interpretation: Python read-transfer counter increased while native read/write transfer counters stayed unchanged across the measured interval. This supports substantial launcher-side read activity; it does not identify every byte or prove physical disk saturation.

There are 993 source-proof references but only 227 distinct path/digest commitments across the fixed cases. Current code reloads and source-verifies cases before and after their paired arms, so shared raw ancestors can be read repeatedly.

The cumulative process read counter includes reads beyond the 8.358 GB source inventory, such as other verification/runtime inputs. Logical read counters are not unique source volume, physical disk reads, cache misses or memory-mapped/GPU traffic.

At the observed partial checkpoint, total arm elapsed time is materially smaller than launcher wall age. Source/model verification, admission, verification outside arm timers and startup are plausible contributors; no complete time attribution is available.

future_options_not_applied.option: Deduplicate raw-ancestor hashing within one explicitly defined verification transaction.
future_options_not_applied.requirements: Preserve every case-specific role, ancestry, temporal, receipt and exact source-claim check. Reuse only an identical path/digest/content commitment under a verified stable read view.

future_options_not_applied.option: Use immutable content-addressed inputs or a filesystem snapshot with enforced write exclusion for cross-case byte-verification reuse.
future_options_not_applied.requirements: Validate original bytes before entering the immutable view, bind its identity in the plan, preserve original-row/source lineage, and verify the final closure. No stat-only or lifetime cache may silently replace byte verification of mutable sources.

future_options_not_applied.option: Reuse immutable parsed/admitted stores while repeating hypothesis/case/source-proof contract checks.
future_options_not_applied.requirements: Separate byte-identity verification from case admission. Invalidate on any permitted source/receipt/configuration change; test tampering, races, mixed source roles and original-row joins.

future_options_not_applied.option: Instrument future runs by phase and use OS I/O tracing appropriate to Windows.
future_options_not_applied.requirements: Measure model verification, source hashing, parsing/admission, retrieval, native dispatch, semantic verification and sealing separately; distinguish logical I/O, physical I/O, mapped model pages and host/GPU memory. Freeze this instrumentation before a new run.

explicit_limits: No change to current budgets, proof checks, scheduling, source/code freeze, model or active processes.
No completion-time estimate, full-run resource total, comparative-quality result or clinical inference.
No automatic monitor or recurring task created; this observation task ends with this checkpoint.
